# Limits and constants

*Generated by `node authoring-kit/scripts/limits.mjs` from the limits Story Block exports; do not edit by hand. The checker (`node authoring-kit/check.mjs`) is the final word.*

## A pack file

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| One pack file | 524,288 bytes of UTF-8 |
| Nesting of objects and arrays | 16 |
| Keys in one object | 200 |
| Entries in one list (records of one kind included) | 1,000 |
| Characters in one string | 4,000 |
| A display name | 80 characters |
| A slug | 64 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single dashes |
| An item, place or skill-template note (host records) | 500 characters |
| A tag or slot word | 40 characters |
| Problems listed for one pack | 20, then the checker stops: fix and run again |
| Quest ranks in `content.ranks` | 12 |
| Money scale (`economy.scale`) | 0.001 to 1000 |
| A recipe's difficulty `dc` | 5 to 40 |

## A rules pack (schema 2): sizes

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| Classes | 1 to 40 entries |
| Skills | 3 to 120 entries |
| Written branches | 0 to 1000 entries |
| Item rules (one per item in `content.items`) | 0 to 1000 entries |
| Trainers | 0 to 100 entries |
| A class's skills | exactly 3, each owned by one class |
| A skill slug | 52 characters (room for the branch suffixes) |
| A name | 1 to 80 characters |
| A note in the rules, foes and quests | 0 to 240 characters |
| All forms after expansion (bases, written and generated) | 2,048 |
| The expanded rules as JSON | 2,097,152 bytes |
| Stats | STR, VIT, AGI, DEX, INT, LUK, CHA |
| A stat value (foes, `requires`) | 1 to 99 |
| Equipment slots | weapon, offhand, head, body, legs, feet, accessory-1, accessory-2 |

## Classes, tiers and branches

| Tier | Unlocked at level | Base form budget | Step 1 form budget | Step 2 form budget |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | the start | 12 | no branches | no branches |
| 1 | level 10 | 24 | no branches | no branches |
| 2 | level 20 | 36 | no branches | no branches |
| 3 | level 30 | 48 | 60 | 72 |

Tier 0 classes have parent `null`; every other class has a parent exactly one tier lower; every chain ends at tier 3. Only tier 3 skills have branches: 8 written per skill (24 per tier 3 class) and 4 generated (`-g`) by the engine (12 per class). A written branch must change behavior (target, element, effect kind, type, stat), not only numbers. The class cap leaves at most 37 tier 3 classes, since a tier 3 class needs its three ancestors.

## Skill base form

| Field | Allowed |
|---|---|
| `type` | physical, magic, heal, buff, debuff |
| `cost.mp`, `cost.sp` | 0 to 999 (a physical skill has mp 0; every other type has sp 0) |
| `cost.cooldown` | 0 to 10 |
| `effects` | 1 to 4 |
| `unit` (summon or pet) | null, or kind summon or pet, statShare 10 to 100, poolShare 10 to 100, rounds 1 to 60 |
| `element` | none, fire, ice, lightning, poison, holy |
| `target` | one, all, self, ally, allies |

## Effects

| Effect | Fields and ranges |
|---|---|
| `damage` | target one or all; power 1 to 1,000; element; damageType physical or magic |
| `heal`, `shield` | target self, ally or allies; power 1 to 1,000; element; damageType null |
| `condition` | kind poison, burn, bleed, stun, daze, slow, weaken, regen, guard; chance 1 to 100; rounds 1 to 6; harmful kinds (all but regen and guard) target one or all, regen and guard target self, ally or allies |
| `stat` | stat; amount -10 to 10 but not 0; rounds 1 to 6; a positive amount targets friends (self, ally, allies), a negative one foes (one, all) |

## Power budget

The checker adds a form's effects and compares the total with the form's budget:

| Effect | Score |
|---|---|
| damage, heal, shield | `ceil(power / 10)` |
| condition | `ceil(chance / 25) * rounds` |
| stat | `2 * abs(amount) * rounds` |
| target `all` or `allies` | the effect's score times 3 |
| `unit` is not null | plus 12 once |

Budgets: tier 0 12, tier 1 24, tier 2 36, tier 3 48; each branch step adds 12 (a tier 3 step 1 form 60, a step 2 form 72). Example: a tier 0 single-target physical strike with power 100 scores 10 (fits 12); the same against `all` scores 30, which needs tier 2.

Each form that has a generated child must survive the engine's power-up: +20 power on its first damage, heal or shield effect (so that power is at most 980), else +1 on its first stat amount (at most 9 in size), else +1 round on its first condition (at most 5). The power-up must fit the child's budget too.

## Item rules

| Field | Allowed |
|---|---|
| `allowedSlots` | 0 to 2 of the slots above; empty unless the item's kind is `equipment` |
| `hands` | 0, 1, 2: weapons and off-hand items 1 (a two-hander 2, slot `weapon` only), everything else 0 |
| `requires` | minimum stats, each 1 to 99, or `{}` |
| `weight` | 0 to 10,000 |
| `unique` | optional true or false |

## Foes, quests, shops, recipes, trainers

| Record | Limits |
|---|---|
| Foe | tier 0 to 9; level 1 to 99; all seven stats; skills 1 to 3; loot up to 8 lines (chance 0 to 100, qty 1 to 99); up to 8 loreTags |
| Quest | category main, side, bounty; up to 16 requirements; objectives 1 to 8 (kill, collect, visit, story; counts 1 to 999); reward items up to 8; `durationMinutes` null or 1 to 525,600; `repeat` null or a cooldown of 0 to 525,600 minutes |
| Open quest template | `open: true` and a `rank` that names a pack rank with a reward range; `reward` is coinMin, coinMax, xpMin, xpMax (coin and xp alike inside that rank's reward range, each min not above its max) and no items; `repeat` and `chain` are null |
| Shop | stock 1 to 100 lines (qty 1 to 999); `kind` a slug of at most 40 characters |
| Recipe | qty 1 to 99; materials 1 to 8 (qty 1 to 99); minutes 0 to 1,440; dc 5 to 40 |
| Trainer | skills 1 to 30; fee 1 to 1,000,000 (never 0); minutes exactly 60; up to 8 eventTemplates |

## Progression the engine applies

| Constant | Value |
|---|---|
| Level cap | 99 |
| Start level, start stat, start points | 1, 5, 10 |
| Points per level | 4 |
| Stat cap | 99 |
| XP per level | 100 |
| Class promotions at levels | 10, 20, 30 |
| Skill path steps at levels | 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 |
| Mastery ranks reached at uses | 1, 5, 12, 22, 35 |
| Training | 60 minutes, 2 credits |
